description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema class, which manages configuration directives, their defaults, and schema for the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for adding directives, namespaces, aliases, and serializing/deserializing schema data.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema
classes.description: Class responsible for defining and managing configuration directives, their defaults, and schema for HTMLPurifier.

methods.name: makeFromSerial
methods.description: Unserializes and returns a ConfigSchema object from a stored serialized file.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the singleton instance of the configuration schema.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Defines a configuration directive with its default value, type, and null allowance.

methods.name: addNamespace
methods.description: Defines a new namespace for directives.

methods.name: addValueAliases
methods.description: Defines value aliases for a directive.

methods.name: addAllowedValues
methods.description: Defines allowed values for a directive.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a directive for backward compatibility.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Replaces stdclass directives with type integers where applicable.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Deprecated method for validation, now uses HTMLPurifier_VarParser->parse().

methods.name: deprecated
methods.description: Logs a deprecation warning for static methods.
